headline: Trial Tool Retrieval, assess multi-agent workflows, and audit framework dependencies

calls.title: Trial Gemini Tool Retrieval for Cost Efficiency
calls.text: Integrate Gemini API Tool Retrieval into an existing workflow with 50+ tools to manage large tool libraries efficiently without inflating input token costs and latency.

calls.title: Assess Multi-Agent Architectures for Quality Checks
calls.text: Design a multi-agent review workflow for quarterly investor report reconciliation and test on a sample fund reporting dataset to handle complex quality checks.

calls.title: Caution on Compromised Agent Framework Packages
calls.text: Audit and lock down all dependencies used in agentic workflow development immediately to prevent credential theft from compromised public repositories.
